About SELENE & ARES

SELENE & ARES is a creative project inspired by the Moon, Mars, and the stories of humanity's journey beyond Earth. We aim to bring forgotten lunar and Martian exploration equipment back into the spotlight through an interactive, visually engaging digital experience.

We are looking for support in:

NASA data research and fact-checking

Web development and interactive mapping

UI/UX design and visual storytelling

Creative ideas for presenting space exploration history
